column3: “Its pillars” follows the Hebrew; the LXX reads “its porches.”
“Hooks” is a rare word (perhaps “ledges”); NASB has “double hooks,” and “inside” as “in the house.”
“Rooms of singers” follows the Hebrew; the LXX reads “two chambers.”
“House” is rendered “temple”; NASB follows the Hebrew, which is shorter than the LXX here.
“Eleven” follows the Hebrew; the LXX has “twelve.”
